rationale_md: Mexico enters this Group A opener with a slight edge, holding a 20-point Elo advantage (1610 vs 1590) that translates to home continent favoritism against a technically skilled but traditionally vulnerable South Korean side. The model sees this as a coin-flip encounter with Mexico narrowly preferred, though nearly three in ten scenarios end level—a reflection of how evenly matched these mid-tier powers truly are. Both teams will desperately seek the opening three points, knowing Group A's depth could make goal difference critical come the final matchday.
